title: Lime and Black Asterisk Story Trio
whatItIs: A dark board of three vertical stories with a lime asterisk brand mark: a woman working on a laptop with a big lime asterisk and brand name, a lime story 'Shape the future of your business' with a giant black asterisk at the corner, and an overhead photo of two laptops with a lime headline about connecting teams and data.
whatItMeans: One bold lime mark and colour repeated across photos and flat colour keeps three different stories unmistakably one brand.
techniques: Giant asterisk used as a graphic in every story
Lime headline over a darkened photo
Solid lime story with black text and mark
Story chrome with progress bars and brand row

vocabulary.definition: A star-like mark used as a logo and graphic.
Progress bars and header of a story frame.
A story built only from solid colour and type.
